text: The baby has a fever of 101 and I'm really worried.
He hasn't had a wet diaper since this morning and he won't feed.
My partner keeps yelling at me and won't let me leave the house with the baby.
I walk on eggshells at home. He checks my phone and says I'm nothing without him.
My c-section incision is red and oozing and it smells weird.
The bottom of my stitches came apart and there's some yellow stuff coming out.
My partner and I bickered about whose turn it was to change the diaper, then laughed.
Took the baby to her checkup and she's gaining well.
My incision is itchy but it looks like it's closing up.
My partner took the baby for a walk so I could nap.
